HackerRank continuously updates **[project stacks](<https://candidatesupport.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402913877523-Execution-Environment#frontend-backend-full-stack-mobile-data-science-and-devops>)** to ensure library questions remain compatible with the latest technology. If you have created custom questions using an older stack, these questions will be flagged by HackerRank, indicating an upgrade is available. It is recommended that you upgrade the flagged questions to maintain a seamless test experience for the candidates.

**Note:** You will notice this flag only when an older version of the question is present in one of your tests. 

**Steps:**

  * Click on the green arrow icon to upgrade the question flagged in a test. ![](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734239992804-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=ZyXmk9MV8K6b-vT6WfSQ3dR-J01RrbwiAAKwya4aAIAynupVb-eh6E~b1CvJtVwnc5O2zP17guB11yREClEjKFEIQyr52rjQJdx7STiaIEa~CoYaYkX-Kqa1lp5pbiLkrQ2XO7xcmY5hzQhc2lMOgsXvjP9qsHOkARTrCa2A-NMPBS1gSBinqAHif3cXFZRVAOpMhIS68zyFacmoDINnBdHP7~crDY25SRU9fGDwW0za8-hgvniohMeLjlCtC~ymgbRZm7l-DhPMoE6QjJy6EDzvHHsNIN7AbaUNSECMrAfgcCGquOOvN98~KHlSG5kOG0kvcTLORxfrf~duMUGNaw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)
  * On the following popup, review the details and click on **Upgrade**.![](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734239993516-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=FHkERqcUawe4w7a4aWPZow3-6m8gJ7vvIm2b-VAaWoK4cxIzGMCd6b3FZSi5wLFukPGs3qfvpr9Qjp6QeUn83Bu~t~ZjdwcGk2HhS7cxsv4q7FCOJRT49W2VE6xcngQRD7ZKPRXMqqsaC7zGzlidYQalA6f6LQx9LzSJ9uOqhnneSF8klXoOrJHi3jTOTxvQauJkrCZ1m1EVa79BTLQfk78R6YEkoGxz60r8gKXktCZKEVcGWfUAbjNzCg~wJ7LXs-L14OOV~Sk~WokwdXvEN9W9Y-yj~dM1sQS5sZSTCM~LmQMcetK-W22r5-jrT5zI6RBTB~wcvzMl1UfgvTCkRg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)
  * In the next step, validate the by clicking on **Validate & Upgrade. ![](data:image/png;base64,)**
  * If the validation fails, refer to the validation, identify the reasons provided, and update the project accordingly.
